aggregation_rule: Never pool sources into one universal accuracy. Report task/source strata and denominators.

answer_set_examples.scope: Optional synthetic FAQ cohort; excluded from the frozen phase-1 matrix and headline claims.

schema.answer_set: Unique, nonempty declared semantic option IDs.
schema.target_distribution: Finite values in [0,1], abs(sum - 1) <= 0.0001, and strictly positive support exactly equals answer_set; accepted targets are normalized before expected metrics.
schema.multi_answer: Must omit label, target_option_id, and target_letter.
schema.singleton_projection: Optional complete label/target_option_id/target_letter projection; all fields must agree with the singleton answer_set and option index.

metrics.expected_nll: Expectation under normalized target_distribution with a 1e-12 prediction floor; full cohort only when every row has a distribution.
metrics.brier: Expected multiclass Brier score under normalized target_distribution; full cohort only when every row has a distribution.
metrics.acceptable_set_probability_mass: Sum of predicted mass on answer_set; full cohort only when every row has a distribution.
metrics.top_1_in_set: Full-cohort rate; exact ties are in-set only when every tied maximum is acceptable. Native predictions provide this metric, but no probability metric.
metrics.valid_only_denominators: The *_valid_distributions_only metrics use valid distributions; top_1_in_set_valid_decisions_only uses parsed decisions.

answer_set_examples.hard_only_paths: Screening and paired comparison accept legacy hard rows and complete singleton projections; reject unprojected singleton and multi-answer rows.
answer_set_examples.heldout_source_review: Independently review heldout or sourced rows before evaluation or claims.

metrics.authored_wanli: Hard-label accuracy, balanced accuracy, NLL/Brier, source-group intervals; populations separate.
metrics.every: Author-label agreement for154 nodes, retrieval Recall@1/3 and MRR, ten frozen composed firewall actions.
metrics.speed: Complete wall time, decisions/s, per-state latency and peak VRAM on one RTX3090; model load excluded.
metrics.stability: Argmax flip rate and absolute probability movement under predeclared perturbations.
metrics.typesafe: Equal-case agreement and probability distance to released model-reference mean; not human accuracy.
